$comment: Per-ID alignment provenance for the 1630 edition: same-day (an ID of the same day, matched on its 1749/2004 Latin text or, for IDs attested only in the 1914 English, on the name), cross-day (a new ID for this day with its twin's slug, linked by same_eulogy), override (reviewed, scripts/data/align_1630_overrides.json) or coined-deprecated. Scores are text similarities; all draft.
